title: Blue Green Diagonal Stripes Pattern
author: archiegupta1908
description:
What you get: 10 JPEG seamless patterns in a ZIP file
NOTE: THIS DESIGN HAS BEEN MADE BY ME ON PROCREATE. (NO AI)
Add a fresh, modern touch to your creative projects with this Blue Green Diagonal Stripes Seamless Pattern Collection. Featuring stylish diagonal stripe designs in beautiful blue and green tones, this versatile digital paper pack is perfect for both modern and classic crafting projects.
These seamless geometric patterns are ideal for print-on-demand products, digital scrapbooking, stationery, fabric design, wallpaper, packaging, invitations, backgrounds, apparel, and other creative projects. The repeating stripe designs make it easy to create larger backgrounds without visible seams.
What’s Included:
10 high-resolution JPEG seamless patterns
Size: 3600 × 3600 pixels
Resolution: 300 DPI
Seamless/repeating designs
Blue and green color palette
Ready for both digital and print projects
Whether you’re designing POD products, scrapbook papers, stationery, textiles, social media graphics, or decorative backgrounds, these blue and green stripe patterns provide a clean and eye-catching foundation for your creations.
